report.executiveSummary: During the incident window, Contoso Retail customers experienced degraded checkout and product catalogue performance (p99: 95ms). Investigation evidence indicates the root cause is most likely associated with the active failure domain, specifically: No strong anomaly detected across client, server, host, or SQL telemetry during the sampled window.. Azure Cosmos DB service-side health remained nominal (server-side latency: 12ms). Azure SQL Database remained healthy. Immediate corrective actions are identified and safe to execute without service escalation.
report.engineeringRca: Telemetry shows p99 latency at 95ms with 0 Cosmos 429 events, 40 RU/min consumption, host CPU 18%, and SQL latency 32ms. The active toggles (none) directly align with the observed failure signature. The client-to-server latency delta of 83ms indicates most latency is introduced in the application, SDK, query design, or host execution path rather than inside the Azure Cosmos DB service plane.
